import java.util.ArrayList;
import java.util.Arrays;
import java.util.Scanner;

public class Cutting {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		Scanner s = new Scanner(System.in);
		int n = s.nextInt();
		int B = s.nextInt();
		int[] arr = new int[n];
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			arr[i] = s.nextInt();
		}

		int cut = 0;
		int odd = 0;
		int even = 0;
		ArrayList<Integer> money = new ArrayList<>();
		for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
			if (arr[i] % 2 == 0) {
				even++;
			} else {
				odd++;
			}

			if (even == odd && even != 0 && i != n - 1) {
				money.add(Math.max(arr[i] - arr[i + 1], arr[i + 1] - arr[i]));
			}
		}

		Arrays.sort(money.stream().mapToInt(Integer::intValue).toArray());
		for (int x : money) {
			if (B >= x) {
				cut++;
				B = B - x;
			}
		}

		System.out.println(cut);
	}

}
</perturbed_code_1>
